data.name: Bhart
data.gender_notes: Bhart is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bhart is derived from the Sanskrit word Bhartā, which means 'the sustainer or supporter of the world'. In Hindu mythology, Bhart is an epithet of Vishnu, the preserver god, who holds the earth on his back. This name is considered auspicious and bestowed upon a child with the hope that they will grow up to be strong, steadfast, and supportive.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine presence of Vishnu in the individual, inspiring them to uphold the values of righteousness, compassion, and sustenance.
data.etymology: Bhart belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhart total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
